status: 겨울철새 10만 마리 이상 · 텃새 수만 마리
summary: 평지와 구릉, 농촌과 그 주변 야산에 사는 흔한 텃새이다. 밥그릇 모양 둥지에 알을 2~5개 낳는다. 평소에는 잡초와 곡식의 씨를 먹다가 여름에는 곤충을 많이 잡아먹는다. 전국에서 살며 국외에서는 만주와 우수리 등지에 분포한다.

sexes.male: 머리와 등은 어두운 녹갈색, 가슴과 배는 어두운 황갈색이고 부리는 밝은 분홍색이며 온몸에 녹색 빛이 돈다.

art.subject: Oriental Greenfinch (Chloris sinica), adult male, as seen year-round in the Korean countryside: crown and nape grey; forehead, face and ear-coverts olive-green, darkest around the eye; mantle and back warm chestnut-brown; breast, belly and flanks warm olive-brown with a yellowish wash; undertail coverts yellow; wings black with a broad, bright yellow patch across the base of the flight feathers; tail black, forked, with yellow bases to the outer feathers. Thick conical bill pale pink; dark eye; pinkish-brown legs.
art.pose: perched on a weed stalk, picking seeds
art.scene: Korean countryside: low hills and farm fields at the foot of a wooded hill; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched on a weed stalk: grey crown and nape, olive-green face, warm brown back, olive-brown underparts, yellow undertail, black wings with a bold yellow patch, pale pink bill, forked black tail with yellow at the base
adult female, side view perched: like the male but duller and paler, with a brownish head showing little grey, paler olive-brown underparts and a smaller yellow wing patch
adult male in flight seen from above: bold yellow band across black wings, brown back, forked black tail with yellow bases to the outer feathers, head, body and tail in a straight line
art.build: Small, stocky finch, 14cm, about sparrow-sized but bigger-headed and thicker-billed, perching on weed stalks, treetops and wires. Bill thick, conical and pointed, much shorter than the head, pale pink. Legs short, pinkish-brown. At rest the long black wingtips extend onto the tail, and the yellow wing patch shows as a yellow line along the closed wing. Tail fairly short and clearly forked. In flight the broad yellow band across the black wings and the yellow tail sides are striking.
avoid: Do not paint a uniformly bright green body like the European Greenfinch; this species has a brown back and olive-brown underparts.
Do not paint a dark or grey bill; it is pale pink.
Do not omit the yellow wing patch or replace it with white wing bars.
Do not streak the underparts like a siskin.
